items.stem: Claude produces a summary of a new regulation for the compliance team. It is fluent, confident, and cites "Section 4(b)(iii)" as the source of a filing deadline. What should the associate do before sending it?

choices.text: Check the cited section against the official text of the regulation.
choices.explain: 正解。具体的に見える固有名詞・条番号・数値はハルシネーションが最も出やすい形。監査対象の読者に渡す前に一次資料で照合するのが必須の手順。

choices.text: Send it — the level of detail shows the model had the text in front of it.
choices.explain: 不適。詳しさは正しさの証拠にならない。もっともらしい細部を作れることがこの技術の特徴。

choices.text: Ask Claude how confident it is, and send it if it says "very confident."
choices.explain: 不適。自己申告の確信度は精度の指標として信頼できない。

choices.text: Rewrite it in more formal language and send it.
choices.explain: 不適。体裁を整えても事実の誤りは残る。

items.stem: A brief asked for a vendor comparison covering price, security posture, support SLA, and migration effort. Claude's output is well written and covers price, security, and support — migration is not mentioned.

choices.text: The output fails on completeness; check every deliverable in the brief before judging quality.
choices.explain: 正解。正確さと完全性は別の軸。読みやすい文章は欠落を見えにくくするので、依頼した項目を一つずつ突き合わせる。

choices.text: The output is acceptable — three of four sections is a passing rate.
choices.explain: 不適。抜けた1項目が意思決定を左右するかもしれない。割合で判断するものではない。

choices.text: The omission proves the model is not capable enough; escalate to a more powerful model.
choices.explain: 不適。モデルの問題と決めつける前に、依頼で移行工数を明示したか、資料を渡したかを確認する。

choices.text: Delete the migration requirement from the brief so the output matches.
choices.explain: 不適。評価基準のほうを出力に合わせている。順序が逆。

items.objective: Evaluate Claude-generated outputs for accuracy and completeness

items.stem: Which TWO of the following most strongly suggest an output needs verification before use? (Select 2)

choices.text: A precise-looking citation, figure, or case number that does not appear in any source you provided.
choices.explain: 正解。出所のない具体的な数字・引用はハルシネーションの典型的な兆候。

choices.text: A confident claim about an event or product change that would have happened after the model's knowledge cutoff.
choices.explain: 正解。学習データの範囲外の出来事を断定している場合、根拠は存在しない。

choices.text: The output uses bullet points instead of prose.
choices.explain: 不適。体裁は正しさと無関係。

choices.text: The output is longer than you expected.
choices.explain: 不適。長さは検証の必要性を示さない。冗長さは編集の問題。

choices.text: The output hedges and says it is uncertain about one figure.
choices.explain: 不適。不確実性を明示しているのはむしろ扱いやすい。確認すべき箇所を教えてくれている。

items.objective: Identify hallucinations, inconsistencies, and biases in responses

items.stem: A technically accurate 1,200-word analysis needs to go to the executive committee, who will spend two minutes on it. What is the most appropriate action?

choices.text: Adapt it for the audience: lead with the decision being asked for, keep the numbers that drive it, and move the detail to an appendix.
choices.explain: 正解。同じ内容でも読者と使われ方が変われば適切な形は変わる。編集・適応は Associate の中心的な仕事のひとつ。

choices.text: Send the full analysis unchanged — shortening it would remove accuracy.
choices.explain: 不適。読まれなければ正確さは届かない。要約は精度を捨てることと同義ではない。

choices.text: Cut it to 200 words by deleting the last two-thirds.
choices.explain: 不適。末尾を切ると結論や根拠が落ちる。長さだけを合わせて中身を壊している。

choices.text: Ask the committee to read it in full before the meeting.
choices.explain: 不適。読者の条件を変えようとしている。制約は与件として扱う。

items.objective: Edit, adapt, refine, and compare outputs for the intended audience
